Okay! Imagine you have a magic box (that’s the 3D printer) that can make other things by printing them out, like toys or even another magic box.

Right now, most magic boxes can print lots of different things, but making another magic box (a 3D printer) is really tricky. It’s like trying to build a toy robot with your toy blocks—it’s hard to make all the tiny parts just right!

Some smart people have already made a magic box that can print out most of another magic box, but you still have to help it a little, like putting in some parts by hand.

Maybe in a few more years, the magic boxes will be so smart that they can print out another magic box all by themselves! But right now, it’s almost there, but not quite yet.
